yesCriteria: Supported endpoints and local agent populations are defined.
Defender for Endpoint prerequisites and discovery or runtime protection choices are approved.
Local files, tools, processes, credentials, and user context are within the approved boundary.
Monitoring, containment, privacy, rollback, and removal paths were tested.
evidenceToRetain: Approved endpoint and agent scope.
Endpoint prerequisite and protection configuration review.
Runtime, containment, privacy, test, and owner records.

verificationSteps.title: Define endpoint scope
verificationSteps.instruction: Identify supported devices, local agents, owners, users, and excluded populations.
verificationSteps.location: Endpoint inventory and local agent discovery

verificationSteps.title: Review endpoint controls
verificationSteps.instruction: Confirm Defender for Endpoint state, runtime protection, local access, privacy, and monitoring decisions.
verificationSteps.location: Microsoft Defender portal and endpoint security policy

verificationSteps.title: Test containment
verificationSteps.instruction: Exercise the approved process to stop the agent, isolate activity, preserve required evidence, and remove access.

LocalAgents.noRemediation: Correct endpoint scope, prerequisites, runtime protection, local access, privacy, or containment gaps; retest; and rerun.
LocalAgents.notApplicableGuidance: Not applicable is not allowed when LocalAgents is selected.

WorkIQ.intent: Confirm that Work IQ data and tool access, user or agent identity, on-behalf-of behavior, permissions, actions, and human approval match the selected scenario.
WorkIQ.whyItMatters: Work IQ can ground an agent in work data and tools; unclear identity or action boundaries can expose information or permit actions beyond user intent.
WorkIQ.whoShouldAnswer: Workload and tool owners with identity, data, security, privacy, and AI governance owners
yesCriteria: Each Work IQ data source and tool is required and owned.
Delegated, agent identity, and on-behalf-of (OBO) behavior is documented and least privileged.
Read and action boundaries, confirmation points, and prohibited operations are explicit.
Audit, monitoring, failure, rollback, and user transparency are approved.
evidenceToRetain: Work IQ data-and-tool inventory.
Identity, OBO, permission, action, approval, and prohibited-operation mapping.
Test, monitoring, owner, and approval record.

verificationSteps.title: Map data and tools
verificationSteps.instruction: List each Work IQ data source, tool, action, owner, and business purpose.
verificationSteps.location: Agent 365 tool configuration and solution design

verificationSteps.title: Map identity and action
verificationSteps.instruction: Confirm user, agent, delegated, and OBO context plus permission and confirmation boundaries.

verificationSteps.title: Test the boundary
verificationSteps.instruction: Validate expected reads and actions, denied access, confirmation, audit, failure, and rollback.

WorkIQ.noRemediation: Remove or constrain unapproved data, tools, permissions, OBO flows, or actions; add confirmation or monitoring; retest; and rerun.
WorkIQ.notApplicableGuidance: Not applicable is not allowed when WorkIQ is selected.

AITeammate.intent: Confirm the AI teammate scenario has explicit work, data, tool, autonomy, human oversight, identity, performance, and escalation boundaries.
AITeammate.whyItMatters: A teammate-style agent can participate in ongoing work; unclear delegation or oversight can create incorrect actions, hidden accountability, or excessive access.
AITeammate.whoShouldAnswer: Business process owner with the agent owner, affected team lead, identity, data, security, privacy, and AI governance
yesCriteria: Assigned work, users, affected people, tools, data, and prohibited tasks are documented.
Autonomy, human review, approval, escalation, and stop conditions are explicit.
Identity, permissions, communications, transparency, and records match customer policy.
Quality, safety, reliability, workload impact, rollback, and retirement measures are approved.
evidenceToRetain: Approved teammate role and work-boundary definition.
Data, tool, identity, autonomy, approval, and escalation mapping.
Scenario tests, scorecard, owner acceptance, and review date.

verificationSteps.title: Define the teammate role
verificationSteps.instruction: List assigned work, users, tools, data, decisions, prohibited tasks, and affected people.

verificationSteps.title: Set oversight
verificationSteps.instruction: Define human review, approval, escalation, transparency, monitoring, and stop conditions.

verificationSteps.title: Test real workflows
verificationSteps.instruction: Run approved quality, safety, access, failure, workload, rollback, and handoff scenarios.

AITeammate.noRemediation: Narrow the role, data, tools, permissions, or autonomy; add human oversight and escalation; retest; and rerun.
AITeammate.notApplicableGuidance: Not applicable is not allowed when AITeammate is selected.
